note: The ticket book and Tilly's drawing now cover Juniper only until ten past three, so nothing rules out the white-furred snowshoe keeper during the theft.

patch.value: The ticket book has twelve stamps. Juniper made them from ten past to half past three.
The ticket book has twelve stamps. Juniper made them from three to ten past three.
At twenty past three, I drew Aunt Juniper at her ticket window. The line was so long!
At five past three, I drew Aunt Juniper at her ticket window. The line was so long!
From ten past to half past three, she stamps twelve tickets without a break. She is too busy with the line to notice who walks past outside.
From three to ten past three, she stamps twelve tickets without a break. Then the line is gone, and she sits alone at her window until the bell.
She draws the train, writing the time from the big clock on each page.
She draws the train, writing the time from the big clock on each page. At five past three, she draws Aunt Juniper at her ticket window with a long line.
At twenty past three, she draws Aunt Juniper at her ticket window with a long line.
She draws the water tower and the platform.

3:10 to 3:20 - Barnaby borrows snowshoes from the back of the ticket hut, takes the briefcase through the luggage car's far door, and hides it behind the woodpile in the woodshed. Tilly draws Gus singing at quarter past three and Juniper at her busy ticket window at twenty past three.
